egin{example} \end{example}[left-invariant geodesics on Lie groups]

Source: petersen:page-0192 ↗ def:pet-ch5-geodesic 1. ch5:5.2.11On a Lie group $G$ with left-invariant metric, the integral curves of a left-invariant vector field $X$ are geodesics iff $ abla _XX\equiv 0$; the upper-half-plane Lie group model does not satisfy this, but for a bi-invariant metric and left-invariant $X$, $ abla _XX= frac 12[X,X]=0$; all compact Lie groups admit bi-invariant metrics. \end{example}
